brandingIssueHeightNotANumber: The logo height must be a number.
description: Instance-wide configuration. Defaults live in code; only your overrides are stored, so a setting always resolves even before it is ever set.
masksEmpty: No masks are defined. Every entity type falls back to a plain slug of its name.
masksIssueEmpty: The mask for “{{key}}” is empty, so it would mint nothing.
masksIssueInvalidToken: The mask for “{{key}}” would mint “{{sample}}”, which is not a valid token. Tokens use letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, and start with a letter or digit.
masksIssueKeyRequired: Every mask needs an entity type.
masksIssueNoPlaceholder: The mask for “{{key}}” has no placeholder, so every entity would be given the identical token and only the first could be saved.
masksIssueUnknownPlaceholder: The mask for “{{key}}” uses {{placeholder}}, which is not a placeholder — it would silently generate nothing. Use {slug}, {uuid}, {alphanumeric-N} or {numeric-N}.
masksPlaceholderHelp: A mask is literal text plus placeholders: {slug} (from the entity's name), {uuid}, {alphanumeric-N} and {numeric-N}. The “default” entry applies to any type without one of its own.
masksUnknownType: Unrecognized entity type — kept as stored
resetConfirmDescription: “{{key}}” will revert to its built-in default and your override will be removed.
title: System settings
unreadableValueWarning: This value is not in the shape this editor understands, so it is shown as raw JSON. Fix it here, or reset the setting to its default.
